flow: Start from known unread notifications, mark one read and assert exact count decrement and row state; activate its business action. Test mark-all/delete/new arrival when requested.
grounding: Use actual source data and stable current anchors; new selectors only for required new UI.
Before implementation freeze one continuous browser_check covering the core causal behavior and one important edge; aim for at most 24 actions. Implementation must still satisfy the full instruction.
Use only Harness typed actions, exact expected values derived from source or test input, and end with assert_no_console_errors.
A fixture may arrange preconditions, never write the result being tested. Preserve unrelated routes and interactions.
visual_policy: Prefer deterministic DOM/state/style/geometry evidence; keep a targeted visual check only for explicit requirements those checks cannot establish.
reference_contract: Cause an actual requested host event, e.g. complete an upload from an earlier subtask. Assert that specific event appears. Do not invent an initial success notification or a fixed mock arrival time.

Cause one host event, wait for its row and assert data-read=false, mark it read and assert data-read=true. Then mark-all-read establishes zero unread. Reload and inspect that same event; reopening must never make it unread again.
Select one stable notification row when multiple arrivals are possible. Persistence is checked by reopening the host and panel after reload, preserving read status and content.
Related quest/location context is display data; do not add a navigation action requirement unless requested.
